scope: Exact AST obligations for the named grouping, collation and COUNT constructors, binding and emission.
trust: Pinned PHP AST parsing, builtin SQLite collation and function registry, and the detached checked-list and snapshot primitives.

common: Check::input($argument !== null || $distinctCollation === null, 'A distinct count requires a field argument.');
Check::input($argument === null || $argument->source === 0, 'A count argument must read the single input occurrence.');
Check::input($column->source === 0, 'A grouping key must read the single input occurrence.');
